title: Complete supported JAX ODE and SSA backends

source.contract: Implement supported JAX ODE and SSA backends using the common compiled-model, rate, protocol, and result interfaces. Support functional and time-dependent rates, batch SSA simulation, analytic survival distributions, and automatic differentiation where advertised.

oracle.identity: Analytic exponential survival distribution, mass action kinetics, exact time-dependent integrals, native BNG3 ODE/SSA reference solutions, and automatic differentiation gradients.
oracle.law: Zero-reaction networks produce zero RHS and constant trajectory; unimolecular and bimolecular propensities match mass action; time-dependent rates integrate to exact Gaussian/exponential profiles; SSA batch distributions match first-order survival laws within error tolerance; differentiation with respect to rate constants and initial states matches analytic sensitivity.
